notes.title: Fair Islands VR is coming soon !
notes.content:
Hello there lovely people !

Fair Islands is finally hitting the store this month.

A dozen of mini-games are available for this first version, along with the customizable player houses. However, the game has room for a lot more content, hence the Early Access state.

Our main goal is to reach a decent amount of mini-games with a well-polished experience, along with side activities. Then will comes a multiplayer mod.

During this phase of development, each time a new mini-game join the bundle, I propose to vote for the next one that should be added in the following update.

For this iteration, I suggest the following :

Three-cup monte: That game with three cups upside-down with an hidden item into one of them. Their place are switched quickly a few times, then you guess in which the item is.

Marble maze: Use both hand to rotate the floor of a tiny maze to move the marble to the exit.

A shooting range, with firearm this time.

You can vote right here !

Thanks for your interest, your support, and your love !

Kisses ː8bitheartː
